scope: New isolated triomphe-only candidate versus original dependencies through the qualified engine interface. No production promotion or reinterpretation of the failed combined candidate.

timing_scopes.write: Fresh engine per pass, input WriteBatch construction and old-snapshot acquisition/drop outside measurement; write_applied consumes batch, clones stored data and publishes exact applied position inside call. Each of106groups is one window. Two inert sentinel CF rows are present.
timing_scopes.read: Fresh populated engine/snapshot per epoch. Statically select owned get or borrowed get_resident outside timed loops; only real ReadView dynamic dispatch remains. Time first512 probes, validate all outputs, perform8 same-view untimed passes, then12 warm passes with all outputs checked after each pass.
timing_scopes.per_call: One window per query, return/error check and black_box included. Store result in reserved output buffer after timer stops; validate/drop results after pass.
timing_scopes.whole_pass: One window per512-query pass includes loop and output-buffer stores; validate/drop outputs after timer stops. Mean/window divided by512 is a pass-derived estimate, and p99/window is not request p99.
timing_scopes.snapshot: Populated engine,8 excluded passes then12 measured passes of512acquisitions. Each window includes snapshot acquisition/boxing; destruction outside. Validate snapshot contents outside measured windows.
timing_scopes.correctness: Before timing validate all106live prefixes and old views in both write modes for both workloads; preserve inert Lock/Write CF rows. Each read epoch confirms snapshot isolation after a later write and exact applied-position/revision transition106->107.

interpretation.criterion: Report all means/p99 and both-order directions, original/warm and whole-pass separately. This diagnostic has no production-promotion verdict.
interpretation.limits: No reinterpretation of old10%material/2%read gate. No allocation-count evidence or compiler alignment sweep. Full local correctness/recovery/actual Chaos and matched database/three-copy Redis remain promotion prerequisites.

status: Prospective performance plan; timing/counting driver not yet implemented or executed
timing_reuse: Reuse these exact ordinary-release binaries if all recorded Rust/dependency sources and corpus/protocol remain unchanged; do not introduce counters, flags or a new dispatcher into timing.

allocation_companion.status: Must be implemented and qualified before measured execution
allocation_companion.source: Copy the current engine-interface harness into a separate counting-only build and reuse the existing resident-outlined-mutation allocation counter module verbatim. Preserve API calls, output lifetimes and window boundaries. No counter hooks in timing ELFs.
allocation_companion.validation: Check all outputs and state/old-view positions; independently verify corpus/probes again. Expected owned hit: one value allocation/read; borrowed hits and misses: no value allocation; snapshot boxing counted separately. Compare both arms per case/phase. Counted timing is discarded.
allocation_companion.runs: One baseline/candidate counting pair per22cases, plus one correctness preparation per counting executable.

gates.write_material: All four declared original write cases must reduce pooled mean by at least10%, with better means in both orders. Report all p99/order results; write p99 regression above2% fails the screen.
gates.read_and_snapshot: No pooled mean orp99 regression above2% for the declared read/snapshot cells, retaining first-probe/warm and per-call/whole-pass scopes. Report each order; whole-pass p99 is not request p99.
gates.allocations: Equivalent deterministic per-window allocator requests and live-byte behavior; any mismatch requires explanation/qualification before acceptance.
gates.interpretation: These are component selection criteria for this changed candidate, not end-to-end promotion. The combined candidate stays failed. No threshold relaxation after measurement.
gates.promotion: Material matched database benefit, full local correctness, ordinary recovery, actual Chaos Mesh and matched three-copy Redis throughput/latency still required.
